gaps: realitymix.cz and reality.aktualne.cz surfaced Velká Jesenice ads, but the candidates visible in accessible snapshots were either below the 1000 m2 land minimum or lacked enough verified field coverage to survive filtering.

reality.idnes.cz accessible search snapshots exposed matching rows but not stable detail-page URLs for the retained duplicates, so iDNES was used as duplicate corroboration rather than as the canonical URL source.

The retained land listing shows locality wording drift across portals (Velká Jesenice vs. Velká Jesenice - Veselice), but Veselice is a local part of the municipality Velká Jesenice, so it was kept within municipality_only scope.
